style: Illustration in the style of a Japanese comic essay (clean, confident dark line art, flat colors with light cel shading, simple but very expressive faces, realistic Japanese apartment details), but staged and lit like a tense spy-thriller TV drama: low-key cinematic lighting, strong shadows, a single hard light source, cool teal shadows with warm amber highlights, subtle rim light. The contrast between the cosy everyday home and the dead-serious thriller mood is the joke. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not chibi. Original characters only: they must not resemble any real person, actor or character from an existing TV drama, film, manga or anime. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signs, labels, speech bubbles, captions or watermarks anywhere in the image.
characters: HUSBAND (MAKOTO): Japanese man, 45, an ordinary, timid office worker. Average height, slightly soft round face, droopy eyebrows, thin round silver-framed glasses, short neat dark-brown hair, a permanent nervous, apologetic smile; at home he wears a beige knit vest over a light-blue shirt and grey slacks. WIFE (REIKO): Japanese woman, 43, the sharp "investigator" of the household. Straight black chin-length bob with a side part, narrow sharp eyes, calm and expressionless, a thin silver wristwatch, a charcoal-grey turtleneck sweater and a long camel cardigan, black slim trousers; she often crosses her arms. MOTHER-IN-LAW (CHIZURU, the husband's mother): Japanese woman, 70, short silver bob, red-framed glasses on a beaded chain, a cream knit cardigan with a small round brooch, cheerful, chatty and totally unable to keep a secret. SON (GAKU, their son): Japanese boy, 16, very tall and big for his age with broad shoulders, short buzz-cut black hair, a calm, sleepy, completely expressionless face, a plain charcoal hoodie and black track pants; he never speaks and answers only by showing his smartphone. NEIGHBORHOOD WOMEN: ordinary Japanese women in their 60s, cardigans and aprons, each with a different hairstyle.
vertical: Vertical 9:16 full-bleed illustration that fills the entire canvas edge to edge: no borders, no frames, no panel lines, no blank margins and no flat color bands at the top or bottom. Keep the top eighth of the picture calm and dark (a wall or ceiling in shadow that is part of the scene), because a title will be placed there. Faces must be large, clear and well inside the frame, roughly between 22% and 52% of the height and away from the edges; the lower part of the picture (below about 58%) should hold bodies, furniture or the floor, because subtitles will cover it.
detect_who: WIFE（黒髪のあごまでのボブ・グレーのタートルネック・キャメルの長いカーディガンの40代女性）、HUSBAND（丸い銀縁メガネ・ベージュのニットベスト・水色のシャツの40代男性。半透明の青く光る分身も HUSBAND_GHOST として別に）、MOTHER-IN-LAW（銀髪のボブ・赤いメガネ・クリーム色のカーディガンの70代女性）、OTHER（その他の人）、SON（坊主頭で大柄な16歳の男の子・チャコールのパーカー）、WOMAN（近所の女性たち）

scenes.prompt: Night, a quiet Japanese residential street lit by streetlights. In the distance the HUSBAND walks alone in a casual jacket and sandals toward the glowing light of a small convenience store (no signs, no text, no logos). In the foreground the WIFE, in a camel trench coat and sunglasses, and the very tall SON in his hoodie hide behind a utility pole and a vending machine, tailing him like detectives; the wife peeks out with sharp eyes. The wife's face is large and clear in the upper-middle of the picture.

Inside a brightly lit Japanese convenience store at night. The HUSBAND stands in front of a completely empty refrigerated dessert shelf, shoulders slumped, staring at it in despair, his phone in his hand. No text, no brand logos and no price labels anywhere. His face is large and clear in the upper-middle of the picture, in three-quarter view.

Home, late at night, in the dining room. The HUSBAND, exhausted and sweaty with messy hair, bows deeply and holds out a small plastic shopping bag with a fancy pudding cup (no text) toward the WIFE with both hands. The WIFE, sitting at the table, looks at him with surprised, slightly moved eyes. Both faces large and clear in the upper-middle of the picture.
